from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the final panel (the panel after the last full divider) into each panel.
    divider=next(v for v in set(sum(grid,[])) if sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row)==len(grid)*len(grid[0]) and v not in (0,))
    # full-width separator rows OR full-height separator columns
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==divider for x in r)]
    if rows:
        starts=[0]+[i+1 for i in rows]; ends=rows+[len(grid)]
        # pattern sourced from last panel, match panel height; copy by relative row
        src=grid[starts[-1]:ends[-1]]
        out=[r[:] for r in grid]
        for a,b in zip(starts[:-1],ends[:-1]):
            for j in range(min(b-a,len(src))): out[a+j]=src[j][:]
        return out
    return grid

out=transform(grid)
print(out)

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    full=Counter(r[0] for r in grid if len(set(r))==1)
    divider=min(full,key=full.get)
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if all(x==divider for x in r)]
    starts=[0]+[i+1 for i in rows]; ends=rows+[len(grid)]
    src=grid[starts[-1]:ends[-1]]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for a,b in zip(starts[:-1],ends[:-1]):
        for j in range(min(b-a,len(src))): out[a+j]=src[j][:]
    return out

grid=[[2]*7 for _ in range(20)]; grid[6]=[3]*7;grid[13]=[3]*7
grid[14][5:7]=[5,7];grid[15][4]=7;grid[16][5]=5;grid[18][1:3]=[6,5];grid[19][1]=6
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
